What Are Commercial Modular Buildings?

Commercial modular buildings are structures built in sections (modules) in a controlled factory environment, then delivered and assembled on-site. This process allows projects to be completed significantly faster than traditional construction—often in a fraction of the time—while maintaining exceptional quality and durability.

Most modular building projects can be installed quickly, with many completed in weeks instead of months.
